items.description: Fix the dispatch-exec portable boundary unit test (test/bridges/hooks/dispatch-exec.test.ts, "executes a blocking hook through the portable process boundary") so it no longer depends on the size of process.env: its child echoes the whole environment into additionalContext, which passes the 10,000-character cap of bridges/hooks/context-cap.ts when the environment is large (about 10.6 KB in this container), so the product correctly returns <persisted-output> and the test fails. Keep the proof that the child inherits the whole environment; test-only change.

DIRGITTAG-01 (.planning/BACKLOG.md): add a publication kind for a dir marketplace whose folder is a git work tree to features/lib/published-marketplace.ts, and a cucumber scenario in features/plugin/install-dependencies.feature that installs a constrained relative-path dependency from that marketplace's <plugin>--v<version> tag (the tag clone is keyed marketplace-name:<name> when the folder has no origin, orchestrators/plugin/clone-cache.ts). Prove the scenario fails under a deliberate product break.

HOOKASYNCRESUME-01 (.planning/BACKLOG.md): an async SessionStart hook's answer (claude-hook-async-response, bridges/hooks/async-rewake/registry.ts) carries no SessionStart details or label, so the HKRL-02 resume/fork duplicate removal in bridges/hooks/event-adapters.ts does not see it and it repeats on every resume. Match Claude Code 2.1.295 (an unchanged async SessionStart context is not added again on resume): give the async answer the SessionStart details shape and apply the duplicate removal to it, with unit tests at 100% direct coverage, a cucumber scenario that fails without the change, docs/hooks-compatibility.md updated, and a CHANGELOG parent line recorded in the SUMMARY.
